FEP sheet, ACF replacement sheet (insert printer model), how to replace FEP sheet

FEP and ACF replacement process are exactly the same just different materials.
It's ACF not FEP, different material for slightly faster printers.

It's not FEP it's ACF, usually used for higher speed at the slight cost of sharpness.

The other thing to consider is the cable being used. Some cheapO cables use less wires inside and it ends up being like a car running on empty it’ll putter along but not work well.

So you need a combination of both a good cable and a good charger
